Privacy Policy & Guarantee

Transparent, technically verified client-side privacy. Your files never leave your device.

Zero Server Upload Guarantee

Your photos, PDF documents, text, and JSON data are processed locally inside your web browser. Nothing is uploaded to our processing servers or stored in any database.

How We Protect Your Data

When you use an image converter, PDF tool, text cleaner, or developer utility on TrendWala Tools:

  • Local In-Memory Execution: The file bytes are read by your web browser's local JavaScript/WebAssembly engine into temporary RAM.
  • Zero Transmission: We do not operate a remote conversion server or file upload backend. No files are transferred across the network.
  • Instant Cleanup: As soon as you close your browser tab or click "Clear", the in-memory blobs are completely released from your device memory.

Analytics & Cookies

We respect Do Not Track (DNT) headers and do not track individual identity. We store your theme preference (Dark or Light mode) locally in your browser's localStorage without any personal tracking identifiers.
